name: Fire suppression discharged-status interface
aliases: switchrooms Switchroom fire and emergency interfaces
summary: Receives the suppression installation's declared discharge-status output.
description: Receives the suppression installation's declared discharge-status output. A fire-system interface passes defined indications and control requests between the fire installation and electrical equipment. The receiving circuit must identify the exact purpose of the signal and the equipment it affects.

In a switchroom, the fire panel may report detection, system faults and a separately documented shutdown request to the station controller. These signals have different meanings and must not be combined into one unexplained alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Discharge status contact” at the input and “Station discharge indication” at the output. The indication does not establish suppression effectiveness.

Use the coordinated fire cause-and-effect schedule to define each response. Original interface blocks describe signal roles without specifying suppression operation, evacuation behavior or life-safety performance. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
